outcome: miscarriage in first pregnancy after recruitment
cohort: The study included a total of 1,473 women with recurrent miscarriage.
finding: In women with two or more previous miscarriages, exposure to cesarean section increases the risk of future miscarriage, and women with three or more surgically managed miscarriages are also at a higher risk of subsequent miscarriage.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section increased the risk of future miscarriage by 31-50% in women with two or more previous miscarriages.
